notes:
Summary: Enterprise procurement for Private VPC deployment.  Ochre runs sensitive PII and regulated insurance claims; primary ask is a hardened VPC deployment with strong KMS and audit controls. Security wants a completed SIG + CAIQ and a shared-responsibility matrix mapping Redwood features to Ochre controls.

Key asks from SecOps/Legal: 
- Full SIG (downloaded) and completed CAIQ (partial answers provided; need vendor detail on KMS key lifecycle).
- Encryption: customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM) required; need key rotation policy and support for multi-region key aliasing.
- Audit logs: immutable, tamper-evident access logs with 7+ year retention optional (default 90 days). Ability to ship logs to customer S3/CloudWatch or to an on-prem SIEM.
- Data residency: primary residency in US (NA) for PHI-adjacent data; some EU residency needed for EU-member claims. Request: confirm region pinning and proof (SOC-type attestation or architecture diagram).
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink required; no public internet egress for inference lanes.
- Shared responsibility: procurement requires a 1-page matrix describing which party performs key controls (KV cache persistence, prompt metadata redaction, model updates, incident response contact).

Sales notes / convo snippets: 
- "We need to see the CAIQ filled out before legal will sign." — Ochre SecOps (Lisa M.)
- Ochre is price-sensitive but prioritizes security; willing to sign up for dedicated reserved capacity if residency & KMS checks pass.

POC status: 
- Small POC run on hosted API last month for embeddings (cost baseline). Performance acceptable but SecOps blocked production without VPC deployment and KMS controls.

Ask of Redwood: 
- Provide completed SIG and CAIQ exports + a one-page shared-responsibility matrix (template attached).
- Provide KMS integration runbook and sample Terraform snippets for customer-managed CMKs.
- Confirm audit log delivery options and retention SLAs.
- Provide draft SOW for Dedicated/Private deployment with proposed timelines and a stub SLA clause for fallback model routing.

Decision factors: resiliency + provable controls > marginal price differences. Procurement timeline aggressive: target sign 2026-04 if security intake passes.

requirements_summary: Ochre requires Private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS preferred), immutable audit logging delivered to customer-controlled storage, per-region tenancy/residency controls (US primary, optional EU), SSO (SAML) for admin access, SOC2/ISO evidence, and a documented shared-responsibility matrix mapping Redwood features (cache, model updates, telemetry) to Ochre operational controls. Latency SLOs: 95th percentile < 300ms for short chat/reranking flows; throughput target 200 concurrent inference sessions with burst capacity. Cost sensitivity: mid-high (willing to commit reserved capacity for residency guarantees).
